name: Fluent 2
fit: Productivity apps that share a neutral, shared, and brand palette.
principles: Motion explains hierarchy. It is not decoration. Color is not the only signal: pair status color with text or an icon. Guidance is split by platform.
color: Three palettes. Neutral is black, white, and gray for surfaces, text, and layout. Shared is for reusable pieces such as avatars, calendars, and badges, including semantic status colors. Brand marks the product on buttons, calls to action, and selected states. Global tokens hold the palette values. Alias tokens name the role, so a screen does not pick a hex. In dark mode the shared palette shifts in saturation and brightness.
typography: Web roles, set in Segoe UI: Caption 2, Caption 1, Body 1, Subtitle 2, Subtitle 1, Title 3, Title 2, Title 1, Large Title, and Display, with Regular, Semibold, and Bold weights. Windows, Mac, iOS, and Android each have their own ramp and native family. Sentence case. Left aligned for left-to-right languages.
themes: Light and dark. Interaction darkens a control from rest to hover to selected, except on Windows, where interaction lightens it. Focus keeps the control color and adds a thicker stroke. People can personalize the scheme.
adapt: Keep the three palettes and the alias roles. Replace Segoe and the Microsoft brand colors. Use the ramp for this product's platform.
